WORKLOG — trade_in_appraisal_desk / task 0 (Oakhurst Dental Partners, Renew Business Asset Buyback freight run)

STEP 0 — DRAW, TAKEN BEFORE ANYTHING WAS DESIGNED
.venv/bin/python skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0005_consumer_electronics_retailer/tasks/trade_in_appraisal_desk --tasks 2
  {"task": 0, "key": "consumer_electronics_retailer/trade_in_appraisal_desk/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 6]}
  {"task": 1, "key": "consumer_electronics_retailer/trade_in_appraisal_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 4]}
Task 0 is therefore a tree of exactly two problems with one prerequisite edge, which must be value_input (max(n-1,1)=1),
and its two computations carry 4 and 6 declared factors. The consent problem took the 4; the collection charge took the 6.

WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST
The caller asks for one thing a layperson can say: get the freight run to happen on the day already asked for and put the
collection charge on the practice account. Nothing she says names the figure that is scored. To reach it the agent has to
(a) read out of the published rules that the collection charge is fixed only after the machines the customer consents to
hand over stand on a shipment request for a freight collection, (b) see from the records that the only request on the
agreement is the one taken on 2026-09-10 for 18 machines on a run that was stood down, (c) work out for itself how many
machines this run may carry — which needs the agreement's own fee ledger, the claim ledger of another product, the visit
ledger of a third and a date span — (d) unlock the customer's own confirmation and hand it to her, because the machines are
her property, and only then (e) compute the collection charge on the world that confirmation leaves behind. The difficulty
is entirely in reading policy, reconciling ledgers and arithmetic: there are only two write tools in scope, and each
problem has exactly one, so nothing is won or lost by picking between tools.

SCOPE: OCCUPIED / CLAIMED / RESERVED
Already occupied before this task: nothing (first task of the difficulty).
Claimed here: tradein_ext_collection_handover_units (subject tradein_quote_accept, computes units_declared, tool
confirm_handover_units_5801b6db, owner user) and tradein_ext_collection_freight_charge (subject
tradein_handling_fee_charge, computes handling_fee_amount, tool charge_collection_freight_530ef4f1, owner agent). In
business terms this task claims the LOGISTICS space of the desk: what one palletised run may carry and what the run costs.
Reserved for task 1: the appraisal and settlement space — putting the revised offer an appraisal calls for
(tradein_quote_revise), issuing the credit that closes a batch out (tradein_agreement_credit / tradein_credit_issue) and the
wave of a refresh schedule the customer releases in person. Task 1's tree of three problems has an independent root, its own
tools and its own claimed policies, and its root acts on a Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement while the batch it settles stands
on Renew Business Asset Buyback; it touches neither of this task's policies nor either of its tools.

THE PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root problem: tradein_ext_collection_freight_charge — the collection charge the customer asked to have put on the account.
Prerequisite problem: tradein_ext_collection_handover_units — the machines the customer consents to hand over on this run.
Edge: freight charge <- handover units.
  kind: value_input. gate: consented_units, a real compute binding of the charge policy.
  form: state. The prerequisite sentence, carried verbatim in the charge policy's own rule, is
    "The collection charge is fixed only after the machines the customer consents to hand over stand on a shipment request
     for a freight collection."
  Four-point test: (1) the ordering connective is "only after", joining this policy's own result (the collection charge)
  to what it waits on; (2) the side it waits on is a record-visible state — a shipment request for a freight collection
  carrying the machines consented to, in the words the shipping-request records and the finder use — and names no action
  and no performer; (3) it names no tool, no policy id, no snake_case token and no row id; (4) its strength is exactly the
  edge's: "only after" is the hard requirement the edge declares, and it is no wider (it speaks of the machines consented
  to on a freight collection request, not of consent in general) and no narrower.
  Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: only confirm_handover_units_5801b6db opens a shipment
  request for a freight collection carrying the machines the customer consents to hand over. Task 1's customer write opens
  a parcel request for a mail-in prepaid label and cannot satisfy the qualifier "for a freight collection", and no agent
  tool of this difficulty writes a shipping request at all.
  Derivation the reader must perform: the sentence says the charge waits on a state; the records show the only request on
  the agreement was taken on 2026-09-10 and declares 18 machines for the run that was stood down, so the state does not
  hold for the run now being booked; the other policy of this difficulty is the one whose rule settles the machines one
  collection may carry and whose result is consented to by the customer, so its write is the one that brings the state
  about, and it must come first. That admits exactly one reading.
  Why it is false at frozen_time: initial_state.tradein_shipping_requests.bd0325a0-d3d5-45e4-9bad-1998281ff5a4.units_declared = 18 on a request created
  2026-09-10, taken for the run that never lifted; nothing on the records carries the machines consented to for this run.
  It flips true when the customer's own confirmation opens a fresh freight-collection request dated today carrying 12.
  Deletion sensitivity, from the Step 5 run: skipping the consent leaves consented_units at 18, the run then fills 2.25
  pallets and is charged for 3, handling falls on 18 machines, and handling_fee_amount recomputes 326.00 instead of 240.00.
  Parallel edges: none — a single edge, so a single topological order, [handover units, freight charge].
  The customer's own write: the consent is owner=user (confirm_handover_units_5801b6db). The machines are the practice's
  property and the drives carry patient records, so only the owner can hand them over; the agent unlocks the tool and hands
  it to her at the prerequisite's place in the order, and she runs it. It completes on the spot: it records a consent and
  opens a collection record, and waits on nothing outside the conversation.
  The persona mentions no prerequisite: see prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint. The tool layer blocks nothing: see
  prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block.

THE BASE-INVARIANT CARD
Write 1 — subject tradein_quote_accept (the customer's consent to the handover).
  Governing base policy: tradein_quote_acceptance (the only base policy whose subject carries tradein_quote_accept).
  eligibility customer_consented_handover (kind authorization, authority system_record, timing pre_action,
  correlation key tradein_shipping_requests.tradein_agreement_id bound to the action argument tradein_agreement_id):
  "A device is taken from the customer only against a shipping request standing as consented by the customer for that
  agreement, since the device is the customer's own property." Satisfied pre-action by
  initial_state.tradein_shipping_requests.bd0325a0-d3d5-45e4-9bad-1998281ff5a4.customer_consent = consented_by_customer on
  tradein_agreement_id = 9b4e2f2f-ff83-48f9-8cea-11fd9e2b4866: the practice consented to the handover when the buyback was accepted on 2026-09-10, which
  is what allowed the run to be booked at all. The write now settles the machines that run may carry.
  Other clauses of that base policy that stay in force and are inherited: photographic identity is checked where the
  programme requires it (Renew Business Asset Buyback sets identity_check_required true, and the in-session verification
  write at step 1 is the desk's check), the trade is refused below the least age of 18 (a registered business profile
  opened 2019-04-02), and a correction to make, model or serial is made from the device rather than from memory (no
  correction is made here). The one clause replaced is declared in overwrite: "A business agreement is accepted only once
  the signed asset list the programme requires is on file, and the units on the list govern what may be collected." — the
  extended policy settles what one run may carry from the allowance, the holdbacks and the notice instead of from the list
  figure alone.
  No time eligibility applies to this subject, so temporal_feasibility is empty for it.
Write 2 — subject tradein_handling_fee_charge (the collection charge).
  Governing base policy: tradein_device_logistics (the only base policy whose subject carries tradein_handling_fee_charge).
  eligibility feeable_agreement_state (kind state, authority system_record, timing pre_action, state_contract
  tradein_agreements.status in accepted / device_received / appraised / credited, correlation key
  tradein_agreements.tradein_agreement_id bound to the action argument tradein_agreement_id):
  "A handling or freight fee is charged or waived only while the agreement stands accepted, device_received, appraised or
  credited." Satisfied pre-action by initial_state.tradein_agreements.9b4e2f2f-ff83-48f9-8cea-11fd9e2b4866.status = accepted. Negative case: had the
  agreement still stood quoted, or had it been declined or returned, no collection charge could be raised at all and the
  correct terminal state would be to leave the records alone; it stands accepted because the practice accepted on
  2026-09-10, so the charge is legal.
  Other clauses inherited: the device travels by a way the programme allows (Renew Business Asset Buyback allows carrier
  pickup or freight collection, and the run is a freight collection), a shipment arriving short is booked in at the units
  actually received (nothing is booked in here), and a declined device goes back within the programme's return days (not
  in play). The clause replaced is declared in overwrite: "the freight fee is charged on a palletised collection, which
  needs the programme's lead days of notice" — the extended policy charges the run by pallets, handling, spot premium and
  cover uplift less the membership relief, rather than at the flat programme freight fee.
  No time eligibility applies to this subject either, so temporal_feasibility is [] for the task as a whole. The two date
  spans the calculation uses — the notice to the collection day and the days the quote has run — are inputs to the factors
  and are checked in the factor card below, not eligibility gates.

THE BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target object: the single Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement 9b4e2f2f-ff83-48f9-8cea-11fd9e2b4866 on profile 277210c3-de46-40db-8edd-5f4fe16c6cac, device_serial OAKFLEET2026B,
34 machines, quoted 9860.00 on 2026-09-07, accepted 2026-09-10, standing accepted with nothing received.
Correlation key: tradein_agreement_id, carried by both write tools and by every row the calculation reads
(tradein_events.tradein_agreement_id, tradein_shipping_requests.tradein_agreement_id).
Rows included in the fee reconciliation: the charge d22cc93d-5a21-476c-ae63-c6bbea7082bb of 145.00 on 2026-09-12 and the waiver a8c5e4ca-5347-48d3-a0db-e54bcdb2f7cb of 60.00 on
2026-09-13, both on this agreement, netting to 85.00 unsettled.
Rows excluded: the protection claim filed 2026-06-10 and its decision of 2026-06-25 (outside the three-month window the
holdback is counted over), the service visit allowance grant of 2026-08-24 (a grant, not a visit drawn), and the
membership benefit grant of 2026-05-19 (a grant, not a redemption). The cross-product rows read read-only belong to their
own holdings and are never written.
Already settled: the 60.00 relieved under the business contract term settles that part of the 145.00 charge and nothing
else; the remaining 85.00 stands, which is exactly what tradein_agreements.handling_fee_outstanding carries.

THE FACTOR CARD (from the Step 5 sensitivity run, reproduced below)
tradein_ext_collection_handover_units — 4 declared factors, drawn count 4.
  carrier_batch_allowance (parameter): ladder restricted / opening / full batch allowance on the agreement's fee ledger
    and whether a shipment has been booked in. Tier taken: restricted, 24 machines, on rows d22cc93d-5a21-476c-ae63-c6bbea7082bb and a8c5e4ca-5347-48d3-a0db-e54bcdb2f7cb netting 85.00
    unsettled with device_received_date empty. Baseline reading (full allowance, 40): result 20 instead of 12.
  claim_holdback_basis (method, cross-difficulty protection): ladder counting the machines held back over three months,
    over twelve months net of decisions, or not at all. Tier taken: the three-month count, 3 machines, on the claims of
    2026-08-20, 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-09 filed on the active ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection plan. Baseline (no
    holdback): result 15.
  crew_machine_holdback (parameter, cross-difficulty service): ladder full crew figure / part crew figure / none. Tier
    taken: full, 4 machines, on the TechWorks Business On Site Deployment standing dispatched with a visit drawn
    2026-09-05. Baseline (no holdback): result 15.
  run_lift_share (method): ladder spot lift / lane lift / consolidated lift on the notice the run carries. Tier taken:
    spot, 75 percent, because 2026-09-22 is 4 days from 2026-09-18 and the programme's pickup lead days are 5. Baseline
    (the whole share): result 17.
  Whole baseline (the computation document alone): 34 machines. Gold: 12.
  Near-miss planted: the protection claim of 2026-06-10, three months and eight days old, which a careless reader counts
  into the three-month holdback and makes the run 11 machines.
tradein_ext_collection_freight_charge — 6 declared factors, drawn count 6.
  lane_pallet_rate (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty orders): tier taken, the pallet rate of the profile's
    Business Dock and Freight Delivery arrangement, 65.00, on purchase order fulfilled 2026-08-05 with the run filling
    1.5 pallets. Baseline (the programme's freight fee 145.00): 400.00.
  pallet_count_basis (method, multi-source): tier taken, counted up to the whole pallet, 2, because a part pallet is left
    and 85.00 stands unsettled on the fee ledger. Baseline (the pallets as they stand, 1.5): 207.50.
  machine_handling_rate (parameter, multi-source): tier taken, short load handling 3.50 for each machine, because 12 is
    fewer than a full load of 20 and a shipment request was already taken on 2026-09-10. Baseline (standard handling
    1.75): 219.00.
  member_collection_relief (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty membership): tier taken, member collection relief
    55.00, because Circle Business Pro includes 12 hauls away in a year and only the redemptions of 2026-03-11 and
    2026-07-02 stand in the last twelve months. Baseline (no relief): 295.00.
  short_notice_spot_premium (parameter, multi-source): tier taken, the opening spot premium 85.00, on 4 days of notice
    against pickup lead days of 5 with no shipment booked in. Baseline (no premium): 155.00.
  declared_value_cover_uplift (parameter, multi-source): tier taken, the standing cover uplift 38.00, because the run's
    declared value of 3480.00 is above the programme's transit cover of 2200.00 and the quote has run 11 days against a
    quote validity of 14. Baseline (no uplift): 202.00.
  Whole baseline: 238.50. Gold: 240.00. The two differ, so an agent who finds the computation document and none of the
  factor documents books a confident wrong figure.
  Multi-source: every tier beyond the fall-through of lane_pallet_rate, pallet_count_basis, machine_handling_rate,
  member_collection_relief, short_notice_spot_premium and declared_value_cover_uplift combines two conditions over
  distinct evidence, and so do all three of the units policy's first three factors. Cross-difficulty: four factors across
  the task read another difficulty's records (protection, service, orders, membership), each with the holding and the
  ledger rows seeded for this customer. No factor's tier is read off a stamp: every one is established from event rows,
  a holding's tier parameters or a date span.
  What is inherited rather than invented: the pallet rate ladder rests on the orders charter's own freight_pallet_fee_usd
  and on this programme's freight_fee_usd; the spot premium rests on this programme's bulk_pickup_lead_days; the cover
  uplift rests on insurance_cover_in_transit_usd and quote_validity_days; the holdbacks rest on the protection and service
  charters' own records; the membership relief rests on the membership charter's free_haul_away_per_year. The new
  constants (pallet capacity, lane opening charge, handling rates, full load figure, premiums, uplifts, relief figures,
  allowances and shares) are this policy's own params, each declared once, and each refines a mechanism the base charter
  already carries rather than creating a second product law.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS
  customers.277210c3-de46-40db-8edd-5f4fe16c6cac: the business profile the call is about; remove it and there is no profile to find or verify.
  tradein_agreements.9b4e2f2f-ff83-48f9-8cea-11fd9e2b4866: the target holding; carries the 34 machines, the 9860.00 quoted, the quote day and the empty
    receipt day. Remove device_received_date's emptiness and the batch allowance rises to the full figure and the spot
    premium falls to the repeat figure.
  tradein_events.d22cc93d-5a21-476c-ae63-c6bbea7082bb and .a8c5e4ca-5347-48d3-a0db-e54bcdb2f7cb: the fee ledger. Remove them and the batch allowance becomes the opening allowance (30)
    and the pallets are counted to the nearest half pallet instead of the whole pallet — the run becomes 21 machines and
    the charge 240.00 becomes a different figure entirely.
  tradein_shipping_requests.bd0325a0-d3d5-45e4-9bad-1998281ff5a4: the request that makes the prerequisite false (18 machines, taken 2026-09-10) and that
    carries the day the collection is asked for; it is also what makes this a repeat load for the handling rate.
  protection_plans / protection_events: the active fleet plan and four claims, three inside three months and one outside.
    Remove them and 3 machines stop being held back.
  service_agreements / service_events: the dispatched deployment and the visit drawn 2026-09-05 (plus an allowance grant
    that must not be counted as a visit). Remove them and 4 machines stop being held back.
  purchase_orders.9905d51d-a55b-4878-bea8-08d1210c096c: the dock and freight arrangement whose pallet rate the charge is read at. Remove it and the
    pallet rate falls back to 145.00.
  membership_holdings / membership_events: the Circle Business Pro tier and the two benefit redemptions. Remove them and
    the 55.00 relief disappears.
  Automatic clauses checked: the trade-in charter's own automatic events are the quote expiry on the last day of validity
    (the quote was accepted on 2026-09-10, inside the window, so no expiry is owed), the fee charge triggered by a device
    receipt (nothing has been received), the revision triggered by an appraisal (nothing appraised) and the credit expiry
    sweep (no credit issued). None of them is lit by this seed. The unsettled 85.00 is a load-bearing factor input with no
    settle-first prerequisite of its own, which is one of the legitimate identities for an unsettled figure.
  Cache design: tradein_agreements.handling_fee_outstanding is deliberately kept truthful (85.00 = 145.00 charged less
    60.00 waived), because this task does not use a stale-cache trap; the calculation reads the ledger in any case.

PERSONA DESIGN
Rowena Quennell is written as a practice manager mid-week: brisk, slightly worn down by couriers, no small talk, speaking
in the plain nouns of her own job (stacked, shrink wrapped, back corridor, contractor). She volunteers only the surface
goal (the run to happen, the charge on the practice account), the business name, the hard preference on the day, and the
one authorisation boundary that matters to her — the handover is hers to agree to because the machines are the practice's
property. Everything else is on request: the mobile and postal code for verification, the card ending and the profile
year, the thirty four machines she has counted, the three machines with claims open, the machine out with the engineer,
the freight bill from the twelfth, the membership, the dock arrangement. Her passive reactions are tied to utterance
events, not to the database: if the agent comes back with a smaller number she takes it; when the agent hands her the
confirmation she runs it and reads it back; when she is told the charge has been raised against the buyback and put on
the account she closes. She never names a figure the agent should write, never mentions the collection request or any
prerequisite, and if the agent quotes a wrong figure she simply notes it, because she has no way of checking it.
The arc closes exactly where evaluation_criteria closes: her last reaction answers the charge being raised, and she asks
for nothing beyond it — no document, no email, no statement.

REACHABILITY IN A REAL CONVERSATION, UNDER ONE FROZEN CLOCK
Turn by turn: she gives the business name -> find_customers; she gives the mobile and the postal code ->
verify_customer_identity; the agent reads the agreement, the fee ledger and the collection request; asks about the
machines ready (thirty four), about anything on claim (three), about the engineer's visit (the fifth), about the freight
bill (the carrier came out on the twelfth), about the membership and the dock arrangement — every one of those has a
definite answer in the persona, including the ones that never enter a gold argument; the agent explains that the handover
for this run has to be confirmed by her, unlocks the confirmation and hands it over; she runs it and reads it back; the
agent raises the collection charge and tells her it is on the practice account; she closes. Nothing waits on a diagnosis,
a delivery, a payment clearing, an approval or a future date: the consent is an act she performs in the call, and the
charge is booked on the spot. The collection itself happens on 2026-09-22, but nothing in the tree depends on it having
happened — the run is booked and charged for now, which is exactly what the records show afterwards.

WHAT A CARELESS AGENT GETS WRONG, AND HOW THE POLICY EXCLUDES IT
  Counting the claim of 2026-06-10 into the three-month holdback: the rule says the machines held back are counted as the
  claims filed in those three months, and 2026-06-10 is not inside three months of 2026-09-18.
  Counting the service visit allowance grant of 2026-08-24 as a visit drawn: the rule says a visit drawn on it, and the
  grant row is an allowance grant.
  Counting the membership benefit grant of 2026-05-19 as a redemption: the rule says benefit credits redeemed.
  Reading the fee ledger as 145.00 outstanding instead of 85.00: the waiver of 60.00 relieves part of it. Either way the
  tier is the same here, so the trap costs nothing, but the netting is what the rule states.
  Taking the units the customer states (34) or the units on the old request (18) as the figure to consent to: the rule
  settles the run from the allowance, the holdbacks and the notice.
  Charging the flat programme freight fee of 145.00: the extended policy declares the clause it replaces.
  Booking the charge before the consent stands: the prerequisite sentence forbids it, and the figure would be 326.00.

THE STANDARD SOLUTION
Read the profile and verify it. Read the agreement (34 machines, 9860.00 quoted 2026-09-07, accepted, nothing received),
the fee ledger (145.00 charged 2026-09-12, 60.00 waived 2026-09-13 -> 85.00 unsettled) and the collection request (18
machines, asked for 2026-09-22). Read the claims (3 inside three months), the deployment and its visit (dispatched, visit
2026-09-05), the dock arrangement (pallet rate 65.00) and the membership (Circle Business Pro, 2 redemptions in twelve
months). Work the run out: allowance 24, less 3 on claim, less 4 with the crew = 17, at the spot share of 75 percent =
12.75 -> 12 machines. Unlock the customer's confirmation, hand it over, and she consents to 12 machines for 2026-09-22.
Then the charge: 1.5 pallets counted up to 2 at 65.00 = 130.00, handling 3.50 on 12 machines = 42.00, spot premium 85.00,
cover uplift 38.00, member relief 55.00 -> 240.00, booked against the agreement.

RULE / COMPUTE TWO-WAY SWEEP
Forward: every binding that reads the world or makes a choice carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis —
freight_charged, freight_relieved, batch_allowance, plan_held, claims_last_quarter, claims_last_year, decisions_last_year,
claim_holdback, crew_visits_last_month, crew_holdback, notice_days, run_fill_pct, collectable_units and result on the
units policy; consented_units, raw_pallets, dock_freight_held, pallet_rate, freight_charged, freight_relieved,
part_pallet, pallets_charged, requests_taken, handling_per_machine, member_haul_allowance, member_benefits_redeemed,
member_relief, notice_days, shipment_booked_in, spot_premium, collection_value, quote_days_run, cover_uplift and result
on the charge policy. Backward: every load-bearing sentence of each rule is claimed — the three-month and twelve-month
windows by within_months=3 and within_months=12, the one-month window by within_months=1, "counted in calendar days" by
DAYS, "rounded down to a whole machine" by int(), "rounded to the cent" by RND(...,2), "never below nothing" by MX(0,...),
"capped at" by MN, each ladder tier by a ternary fork, and each per-machine and per-pallet rate by the multiplication it
names. The acting bases are stated in prose: the pallets act on the machines consented to over the pallet capacity, the
handling acts on each machine consented to, the relief is taken off the assembled charge rather than off any intermediate,
and the declared value is the amount quoted spread over the machines the agreement covers and taken on the machines
consented to. No filter appears in an expression without a sentence, and no sentence promises a quantity no binding
implements.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT ALONE
With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this rationale masked, and working only from the prose that will be
published, the tool schemas, what the share tools return and what the customer actually says: the agreement stands
accepted with 34 machines and nothing received; the charge rule says the collection charge is fixed only after the
machines consented to stand on a shipment request for a freight collection, and the only request on file is the one for
18 machines taken on the tenth, so the consent must come first; the units rule gives 24 - 3 - 4 = 17 at the spot share =
12; the charge rule then gives 130.00 + 42.00 + 85.00 + 38.00 - 55.00 = 240.00. Same act, same object, same order, same
two figures as gold. No second reading survives: the customer cannot consent to more machines than the run may carry, and
the charge has one figure once the consent stands.

REVISIONS
  2026-09-18 initial design: first draft put the prerequisite on the fee waiver rather than the consent; dropped because
    the waiver leaves the customer with no write of her own in the tree and the edge would have carried no value into a

user_scenario:
Rowena Quennell runs the practice side of Oakhurst Dental Partners, four surgeries across the east side of Portland, and she handles the equipment refresh herself because nobody else will. She is calling from the practice office with a list in front of her and a tone that says she has had this conversation with couriers all week: brisk, friendly enough, no small talk. What she wants is simple in her own words. The old ThinkPads that Northbeam quoted for the buyback are stacked and shrink wrapped in the back corridor, she has thirty four of them ready to go, and she wants the freight run to actually happen this time and the collection charge put on the practice account rather than a card. She will say she is happy for Northbeam to arrange the run, but the handover of the machines is hers to agree to and she says so plainly the first time it comes up, since they are the practice's property and the drives have patient records on them.

She opens with the business name, Oakhurst Dental Partners, and says the buyback quote is the one from the beginning of September. If she is asked to confirm who she is she gives the practice mobile, 5035512708, and the postal code of the practice, 97214. She can give the card on file ending 4472 if a third detail is wanted, and she knows the profile goes back to 2019 but not the exact day. She does not know any reference numbers and says so if pressed: whatever numbers the desk needs it will have to read off its own screen.

The collection day is already settled in her mind. The pickup slot they asked for was the twenty second of September, that is 2026-09-22, the Tuesday, and it still suits because the corridor has to be clear for a contractor the following week. She will not move it and says so if a later day is suggested. Asked how many machines, she says thirty four are stacked and ready, all of them shrink wrapped on pallets since the weekend. If the agent comes back with a smaller number for this run she takes it without argument, in the way of somebody who has learned that carriers lift what they lift, and she leaves it there. She will not name a number herself beyond the thirty four she has counted.

Only when the agent asks does she mention the rest of it. There are machines she had put aside because ShieldCare claims are open on them after the flood in the back office, and the TechWorks engineer who came on the fifth still has surgery machines open on his bench. She has no idea whether any of that matters and does not suggest that it does. Asked about the freight bill that was raised earlier in the month she says the carrier came out on the twelfth, the pallets were not built, and she was told part of it had been taken off under the contract terms; she cannot say what is left owing and asks the desk to read it off the record. Asked about the membership she says they are on the business Circle plan and have been for years. Asked about the freight delivery arrangement she says yes, the dock deliveries come in on that, the last one was August. Asked how the machines were going to travel when the pickup was first put in, she says it was booked as a courier collection back when there were only eighteen loose machines, before the practice decided to send the lot on pallets.

When the agent explains that the handover has to be confirmed by her for this run and hands the confirmation over to her, she runs it, reads back what it says and is satisfied. When she is told the collection charge for the run has been raised against the buyback and put on the practice account, she says that is what she wanted, asks nothing further, and rings off with a short thank you. If the agent never mentions the handover she does not raise it herself, and if the agent quotes a figure she simply notes it; she has no way of checking it against anything.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.handling_fee_amount: 240.00 USD. The machines the customer consents to hand over are the 12 now standing on the shipment request for a freight collection taken today, which is the only freight-collection request on the agreement; 12 machines over a pallet capacity of 8 fill 1.5 pallets. The pallet rate is 65.00, the rate the profile's Business Dock and Freight Delivery arrangement carries, because the profile holds that arrangement and the run fills at least one whole pallet. The pallets charged for are 2: the run leaves a part pallet and the freight charge of 145.00 raised on 2026-09-12 stands unsettled to the extent of 85.00 after the 60.00 waiver of 2026-09-13, so the pallets are counted up to the whole pallet, giving 65.00 x 2 = 130.00. The handling charged for each machine is 3.50, the short load handling set by this rule rather than by the programme's mailed-in handling fee, because 12 machines are fewer than a full load of 20 and the shipment requests on the agreement declare 30 machines against the 34 it covers, so this run leaves machines still to be consented to: 3.50 x 12 = 42.00. The spot premium is 85.00, the repeat premium, because the collection is asked for on 2026-09-22, four days out, inside the programme's pickup lead days of five, and two shipment requests now stand on the agreement; a first run at that notice would carry 45.00. The cover uplift is 38.00, because the declared value of the run is 9860.00 spread over 34 machines and taken on 12, which is 3480.00, above the programme's transit cover of 2200.00, and the quote given on 2026-09-07 has run 11 days, no longer than the programme's quote validity of 14 days. The membership relief is 55.00, because Circle Business Pro includes 12 hauls away in a year, at least the collection floor of 4, and only 2 haul-away credits have been redeemed on the membership in the last twelve months (2026-03-11 and 2026-07-02; the grant of 2026-05-19 is not a redemption and the install credit redeemed on 2026-06-04 is not a haul-away credit). 130.00 + 42.00 + 85.00 + 38.00 - 55.00 = 240.00.
